note: What the density-trellis deliberately does NOT declare. The branch classes and the paths they cover are declared by the 'Declares' column of the self-index table in docs/density-chain/DENSITY-CHAIN.md, and wiki_check.mjs derives its routing from there — there is no committed copy to drift against. This file holds only the residue: churn no branch describes, script-naming heuristics no branch should have to enumerate, and the broad fallbacks that catch a genuinely new subsystem. Every entry owes a `why`. No entry may duplicate a declared glob; --verify refuses if one does.
